author: rocksoffjagger
body: Honestly, pvp in this game is not fun. If a match reaches a stalemate like this, I just flee.

author: sm00th101
body:
I've seen people talk about what to do if you aren't being damaged and you're out of Mana/can't do damage yourself and the response has generally been "get gud" . Cool, I want to get higher power, and I can play with using different debuffs, but my gear is pretty decent, and I am using them (like I put this guy to sleep and his PD fixes it pretty quick).

The question isn't so much about how to reduce the chance of a stalemate, but is there anything that can be done to end the battle? I run into this coliseums regularly. There will always be people with extreme defense numbers, dodge often, heal, remove debuffs, etc.

Will the game eventually draw after 1000 turns, has there been a push to reshuffle the opponent after there will clearly be no winner?

author: 1stFunestist
body:
When I finish my daily game I just make my pawn naked and store my pet so in PvP I get killed easily.

There is no point to make difficult to other people as it doesn't affect my account at all.

It would have been different if my AI victories bring something (resources or moneyz) but like this it is just unnecessary to make other people's game difficult.

author: Lord_Xeraxys
body: PVP remains relatively broken. You’re either completely outmatched, destroy them in a turn or two, or you’re in for an excessively long back and forth. If both sides have Recharge, though, then yes. PVP could go on infinitely longer than you’re willing to wait for a winner.
